US Army General's Role Questioned Amidst Pentagon Personnel Review

A review of personnel at the Pentagon, led by Pete Hegseth, has raised questions about the role of US Army General Gary M. Brito. The New York Times reported that Hegseth's actions are seen by some as a "wrecking ball" within the Department of Defense. The Financial Times described Hegseth's review as a "Pentagon purge." The coverage focuses on the potential impact of these personnel decisions on military leadership and operations.
